title: Black-Eyed Pea Stew with Silverbeet
subtitle: a Rosh Hashanah favourite, with honey and pomegranate
description: A stew of dried and fresh black-eyed peas, golden onion and silverbeet, lightly sweetened with honey and scattered with pomegranate seeds.

steps.text: Soak the dried black-eyed peas overnight in water, then cook them in plenty of boiling water for about 30 minutes, until tender. Drain.
Finely chop the onion and fry in a deep pan with olive oil until golden. Add the roughly chopped fresh black-eyed peas and fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add half a cup of boiling water and cook for about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped silverbeet and the seasonings, mix and cook for about 3 minutes.
Turn off the heat, add the cooked dried black-eyed peas and the honey, and transfer to a plate.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds and serve.
